categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen JPT Opto-Electronics Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of lasers, laser/optical intelligent equipment, and fiber optic devices. The company focuses on high-power pulse fiber lasers (MOPA pulse fiber lasers), continuous fiber lasers, solid-state lasers, and ultrafast lasers, as well as intelligent equipment used in semiconductor, integrated circuits, and optoelectronic precision testing and micro-processing. It also develops automation equipment for passive components and photovoltaic devices.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include adjustable pulse width high-power pulse fiber lasers (MOPA structure), continuous fiber lasers with modular design for scalable power, solid-state UV/green lasers with air purification systems, and ultrafast lasers with picosecond to femtosecond pulse widths. Production methods combine order-based manufacturing and batch production, with strict quality control and use of Oracle EBS management system for production planning and execution. The company also integrates laser, optics, testing, motion control, automation, and machine vision technologies into its intelligent equipment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global companies in consumer electronics, semiconductors, optoelectronic components, and new energy sectors such as Apple, Meta, Intel, and CATL. The company serves industries including consumer electronics (smartphones, XR devices), semiconductor manufacturing, passive electronic components, photovoltaic (perovskite solar cells), and new energy power batteries. The markets are primarily industrial manufacturing sectors requiring precision laser processing and optical inspection.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters in Shenzhen and subsidiaries in locations including Singapore, Korea, Japan, and Taiwan. Its products and services cover Asia, North America, and Europe, serving multinational customers and participating in global supply chains.
categories.supply_chain_position: JPT operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of core laser devices and intelligent laser/optical processing equipment. It provides upstream laser sources and midstream intelligent equipment solutions to downstream manufacturers in electronics, semiconductors, and new energy industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in high-power, high-brightness, multi-wavelength, and ultra-narrow pulse width lasers, focusing on pulse fiber lasers, continuous fiber lasers, solid-state lasers, semiconductor lasers, and ultrafast lasers. It also advances intelligent laser/optical equipment integrating optics, testing, automation, and machine vision, targeting high-precision resistor trimming, flexible and brittle material micro-processing, and chip inspection. R&D efforts emphasize customer-driven product customization, cost reduction, and expanding applications in new energy, photovoltaic, and semiconductor sectors.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of laser products, laser/optical intelligent equipment, and fiber optic devices to domestic and international customers. The company employs a direct sales model, engaging deeply with customers during product development and customization phases, and delivers products based on customer orders and production plans.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: JPT is a leading domestic manufacturer and the first in China to commercialize mass production of MOPA pulse fiber lasers, competing with international laser and optical equipment providers. It holds a strong position in the Chinese market with growing recognition globally, especially in new energy and semiconductor laser applications. The company faces competition from both domestic and foreign firms, with market competition intensifying, particularly in laser products.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, JPT achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.23 billion, a 4.46% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 107.4 million, a 39.87% increase. The company’s total assets reached RMB 2.55 billion, with net assets of RMB 1.95 billion, reflecting steady growth. R&D investment accounted for 12.72% of revenue, supporting sustained innovation. The company maintains positive operating cash flow and has a stable financial position with moderate leverage.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: JPT emphasizes advanced laser technology with adjustable pulse width and high peak power, enabling superior processing quality such as burr-free cutting in battery manufacturing. Its integrated intelligent laser/optical equipment combines proprietary laser sources with precision measurement and automation, offering customized solutions that improve production yield and reduce costs. The company’s products are recognized for high reliability, compact design, and technical innovation, supporting domestic substitution of imported lasers and meeting evolving customer needs in high-growth sectors like new energy and photovoltaics.
